'''Kid Malmash''' was a young [[Shungbeek]] who transported fugitives to safe zones in his [[Lancer-class pursuit craft|''Lancer''-class pursuit craft]], the ''[[Nebular Kelpie]]''. In [[35 ABY]], he was one of the [[Citizens' Fleet|many]] unaffiliated [[pilot]]s who answered the call of the [[Resistance]] when they asked for aid in [[Battle of Exegol|fighting]] [[Darth Sidious]] and the [[Sith Eternal]] at the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. After they triumphed, he joined in the celebrations on the [[moon]], [[Ajan Kloss]].

==Biography==
Kid Malmash transported fugitives to safe zones aboard his [[Lancer-class pursuit craft|''Lancer''-class pursuit craft]], the ''[[Nebular Kelpie]]'', for a steep price. This included wanted criminals and political refugees. By the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], Malmash was beginning to run out of safe destinations to take his passengers to. This cut into his profits.<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Malmash's appearance}}</ref> Kid Malmash was one of many unaffiliated [[pilot]]s<ref name="TROS VD" /> who heard a plea for aid from Resistance agents [[Chewbacca]] and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. Malmash and [[Citizens' Fleet|many others]] followed them through the [[hyperspace]] [[Galactic Barrier|anomalies]] of the [[Unknown Regions]] in order to reinforce the Resistance as they fought against the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] above the [[planet]] [[Exegol]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

After the [[Final Order]] [[fleet]] of [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] was destroyed, Kid Malmash was amongst the many participants of the battle who returned to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] to celebrate the victory. As the [[droid]]s [[BB-8]] and [[D-O]] reunited, Malmash danced next to a [[GNK-series power droid]] before moving to stand with the pilot [[AL1-L3]] and the [[bounty hunter]] [[Seleno Chandro]] as the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] spoke with Chewbacca.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Kid Malmash was a [[Shungbeek]] with [[Color|white]] skin and red [[eye]]s. He required an [[argon]]-rich [[atmosphere]] to breath.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Kid Malmash wore a black [[Clothing|suit]] with a [[perspex]] dome that retained an argon-rich atmosphere. He flew a ''Lancer''-class pursuit craft named the ''Nebular Kelpie'', which he modified with stealth technology.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard_40.png|thumb|right|200px|Wizard 40 by Ivan Manzella]]
Kid Malmash first appeared in [[J.J. Abrams]]'s film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> which premiered on [[December 20]] [[2019]].<ref name="Episode IX release date">{{Twitter|starwars|status/907686475512160256|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Star Wars: Episode IX is scheduled for release on December 20, 2019.|archivefile=File:EpisodeXI release date.png}}</ref> He was identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'',<ref name="TROS VD" /> which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on the same day as the film.<ref name="Penguin Random House">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/607902/star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-the-visual-dictionary-by-pablo-hidalgo|text=Star Wars The Rise of Skywalker The Visual Dictionary}}</ref> Concept art of Malmash with much longer arms was created for the film by creature concept designer and senior sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]] and titled "Wizard 40".<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref>
